overview: Explore top tuition-free public universities and TU9 technical institutes in Germany offering world-recognized degrees, modern research laboratories, and strong industry links.

Studying in Germany provides Indian students with access to world-renowned tuition-free public universities, cutting-edge engineering and research laboratories, and globally recognized European degrees.

Edu Hawk Worldwide Consultancy guides Indian students through Uni-Assist applications, APS certificate verification, blocked account setup, German student visa processing, and 18-month post-study work opportunities.
